name: deltapulse
description: DeltaPulse is a web application for active stock and options traders to monitor live financial markets, analyze price action, and execute trades in real time.  It as a simplified version of platforms like Zerodha Kite, TradingView, or Bloomberg Terminal.

paragraphs: An institutional-grade, zero-lag financial market terminal engineered for active equity, derivatives, and crypto traders. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, HTML5 Canvas, and Web Audio API — engineered specifically to demonstrate mastery over high-frequency data ingestion, quantitative derivatives modeling, and 60 FPS frontend performance.
features: The Event Loop Trap: If a WebSocket pumps 50 ticks/sec and each tick calls setState(), React schedules 50 re-renders per second. The browser's main thread chokes, the Garbage Collector runs constantly, and frame rates…
Layout Shift & Jiggle: Without tabular figures, numbers of varying character widths (1 vs 8) cause constant DOM reflows and flickering.
Execution Lag: A 100ms lag in order submission or a delayed quote can cause a trader to suffer catastrophic slippage.
